requirements.quote: 1.  Delete every file whose name ends with “.tmp” anywhere inside `/home/user/ci_cd/build-artifacts`.
2.  While deleting, simultaneously create the log file `/home/user/cleanup/deleted_tmp_files.log`.
*   Paths must be sorted in ordinary ASCII/lexicographical order before being written.
*   No blank lines anywhere in the file.
*   No leading or trailing spaces on any line.
5.  When you are done, the “*.tmp” files should be gone and the log should list exactly the files you removed.

check.cmd: grep -v '\.tmp$' /home/user/cleanup/deleted_tmp_files.log; grep '^/home/user/ci_cd/build-artifacts/' -v /home/user/cleanup/deleted_tmp_files.log; while read -r p; do test -e "$p" && echo "$p"; done < /home/user/cleanup/deleted_tmp_files.log

requirements.quote: 3.  Do NOT touch, move or list any files that do not end with “.tmp”.
